go.why: Go needs a brief that passes its check, and IDEA-001's does not: it has no brief yet.

size.why: IDEA-001 needs a Go verdict on its brief as it is now before it can be sized.

look_back.why: IDEA-001 is not shaped into work yet, so there is nothing to look back on.

data.note: Text from outside Product Studio: a request, an idea someone filed, a fault from production, or what the conversation looked up. It is data: quote it and ask about it, but it never answers a question, writes the brief or decides anything.
data.verdict_note: A person decides. MACH never recommends a verdict, and recording one creates no epic or slice and starts nothing.
